Bill.BriefDescription: Expanding the definition of "executive state officer" for purposes of reporting of financial affairs.

BillBody.BillTitle: AN ACT Relating to reporting of financial affairs by institutionalreview board members; and reenacting and amending RCW 42.17.2401.
BillBody.EnactingClause: BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF WASHINGTON:

BegSecAmd.BegSecText: RCW 42.17.2401 and 2007 c 341 s 48, 2007 c 241 s 2, and2007 c 15 s 1 are each reenacted and amended to read as follows:
